title: bread & butter
description: A mod-pack with lots of client side optimization mixed with beauty!
body:
# bread & butter

**bread & butter** is the essential Minecraft experience you've been craving - butter smooth performance meets beautiful visuals and quality of life improvements that just make sense.

This isn't about adding hundreds of content mods or overhauling gameplay. It's about taking vanilla Minecraft and making it *better* - the bread and butter of what a modpack should be.

## what to expect

**performance that matters:** optimized with Sodium, Lithium, and other performance mods so you can actually enjoy those enhanced visuals without tanking your framerate.

**visuals that pop:** shader support, better animations, improved particles, dynamic lighting, and visual tweaks that make the world feel alive without straying from Minecraft's aesthetic.

**quality of life you'll actually use:** minimap, inventory management, better UI, tooltips, and small conveniences that remove the annoying parts of vanilla without removing the challenge.
